Landing.featuresSubtitle: One integrated platform handling everything - from retail shopping to automated HSIS point posting and partner credit management.
Landing.feat1Desc: RPA bot auto-fills the HSIS portal form 24/7 - eliminating manual entry queues at month-end closing.
Landing.feat2Desc: Dual-tier price transparency: Consumer Price (HK) for general public and Agent Price (HA) + Point Value (TP) for verified partners.
Landing.feat3Desc: Credit line up to IDR 2 million for verified stockists with automatic freeze enforcement if overdue past D+14.
Landing.feat4Desc: Intercity delivery network across West Sumatra & Riau with automatic parcel tariff calculations by weight.
Landing.feat5Desc: Barcode-scanning POS terminal works offline via IndexedDB - syncs automatically when connection is restored.
Landing.feat6Desc: Cross-audit engine compares HSIS SaldoStok.xlsx against local sales DB to detect any mismatch or missing entries.
Landing.ctaConsumerDesc: Browse hundreds of authentic HNI herbal products with transparent pricing. No account required for retail purchases.
Landing.ctaPartnerDesc: Get exclusive agent pricing (HA), accumulate distribution points (TP), and access the full B2B partner portal.
